Specification: This specification models a real-time hour clock by combining a real-valued time variable with an underlying hour-clock module. The outer module introduces a continuously increasing real-valued variable now and assumes a positive timing tolerance constant Rho; an inner module defines a timer variable t that is reset when the underlying hour clock advances and otherwise accumulates elapsed real time. The specification asserts timing bounds showing that the hour clock advances no later than 3600 + Rho seconds and, when it advances, no earlier than 3600 - Rho seconds, and the top-level behavior combines the inherited hour-clock behavior, monotonic real time, and the existence of an inner timer instance satisfying these real-time constraints.
